provenance: Original project fixtures and direct Ohm/Kirchhoff/closed-form RC equations; no Engine-derived answers or added external models. Reuses Stage 1/6 known answers; new ngspice data is unnecessary for a topology-only feature.
runtime: Node 24.19.0 (pinned .node-version), standard library only; routine tests offline
conventions: SI; current positive entering pin1 (source delivering is negative). Contactor coil current enters a1. Component IDs, pin IDs and signal keys match exactly across pairs; derived node/wire/rail IDs do not. Wire snapshots use schema v1 for pre-#130 executability; the project decoder migrates them to the current schema thereafter.
observationOrder: afterEventsAtStep means operate before reading that sample. Divider observations without afterEvent precede the same-step parameter edit; afterEvent:0 follows its first edit. Event takes effect from (newestStep-1)*0.001 s (zero at step 0).

consumers.references: #129 validates data and wire-side netlists/physics only; it does not implement or certify rail solving
consumers.engine: #130 decodes/validates rails; #131 consumes rail side plus partitions, mapped values/states and permutation/repeat checks
consumers.application: #132 bridge and #133 editor-hint tests consume the same JSON; #134 draws these circuits with editor commands and matches component/pin keys; #135 records real desktop evidence
